description: Evaluate a single primer against quality criteria and return a scored candidate.

position.description: 0-based location of the primer in the template (informational).

is_forward.description: True if this is a forward primer; false for reverse.

salt_monovalent.description: PRIMER_SALT_MONOVALENT: monovalent cation concentration in mM (> 0) for the Tm and ntthal structure values (default 50).

salt_divalent.description: PRIMER_SALT_DIVALENT: Mg2+ concentration in mM (>= 0; default 1.5).

dntp_conc.description: PRIMER_DNTP_CONC: dNTP concentration in mM (>= 0; default 0.6).

dna_conc.description: PRIMER_DNA_CONC: primer concentration in nM (> 0; default 50).

opt_gc_percent.description: PRIMER_OPT_GC_PERCENT: GC optimum of the GC penalty terms (default undefined, as in Primer3's code; required when wt_gc_percent_gt/lt != 0 - Primer3 'Primer GC content is part of objective function while optimum gc_content is not defined').

wt_gc_percent_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_GC_PERCENT_GT: penalty weight for GC% above opt_gc_percent (default 0).

wt_gc_percent_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_GC_PERCENT_LT: penalty weight for GC% below opt_gc_percent (default 0).

gc_clamp.description: PRIMER_GC_CLAMP: number of consecutive G/C required at the 3' end (default 0).

max_end_gc.description: PRIMER_MAX_END_GC: maximum G/C among the five 3'-most bases (0-5; default 5 = no limit).

max_end_stability.description: PRIMER_MAX_END_STABILITY: maximum 3' end stability (-dG of the 3' pentamer, kcal/mol, >= 0; default 100 = no limit).

annealing_temp.description: PRIMER_ANNEALING_TEMP: annealing temperature in °C (<= 100; default -10 = off). When > 0 the fraction bound at this temperature is reported as bound and checked against min_bound / max_bound.

min_bound.description: PRIMER_MIN_BOUND: minimum fraction bound, % (default -10; only with annealing_temp > 0).

max_bound.description: PRIMER_MAX_BOUND: maximum fraction bound, % (default 110; only with annealing_temp > 0).

opt_bound.description: PRIMER_OPT_BOUND: optimum fraction bound of the bound penalty terms, % (default 97).

wt_bound_gt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_GT: penalty weight of the fraction bound above opt_bound (default 0; only with annealing_temp > 0).

wt_bound_lt.description: PRIMER_WT_BOUND_LT: penalty weight of the fraction bound below opt_bound (default 0; only with annealing_temp > 0).

selfAnyTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_SELF_ANY_TH: ntthal ANY self-dimer Tm (°C), 0 when none.

selfEndTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_SELF_END_TH: ntthal END1 self-dimer Tm (°C), 0 when none.

hairpinTh.description: Primer3 PRIMER_*_HAIRPIN_TH: ntthal hairpin Tm (°C) = primer3-py calc_hairpin, 0 when none.

bound.description: PRIMER_LEFT/RIGHT_0_BOUND: fraction bound (%) at annealing_temp when > 0 (null otherwise).

libraryMispriming.description: PRIMER_LEFT/RIGHT_n_LIBRARY_MISPRIMING (design_primers with a mispriming library only; null here).

templateMispriming.description: Primer3 template mispriming (design_primers only; null here — no template).

positionPenalty.description: PRIMER_*_POSITION_PENALTY (design_primers with inside/outside penalties only; null here).

minSequenceQuality.description: PRIMER_*_MIN_SEQ_QUALITY (design_primers with sequence_quality only; null here).

maskFailureRate.description: Primer3 masker failure rate (design_primers with mask_template only; null here).

errors.message: Sequence cannot be null or empty
